name: Pipeliners - Technical Errors Audit 2026-09-30
body:
> Audit · Pipeliners · 2026-09-30

# Summary
A live technical error audit on Sep 30, 2026 (`findings.csv`, 15 checks) covering 404s, 5xx errors, broken internal links, redirect chains, HTTP vs HTTPS, duplicate URLs, orphan pages and click depth. Based on a crawl of 176 URLs and 954 resource files, plus GSC crawl stats.

# Key findings
- 404s: 0 of 176 crawled URLs return 404 and no live page links to one. 29 of the 30 known old 404s still 404 with zero live links; Google still requested 404s 408 times in 90 days (7% of its crawl).
- Schema 404s: 5 image addresses in the OTTO Article schema of the Mesa sewer camera post do not exist; 2 more posts point at dead addresses in schema.
- 5xx: none today; GSC host status "No problems".
- Broken internal links: none (928 in-content links and 954 resources all 200). Hidden OTTO "Related Pages" blocks on 5 posts link to redirected posts.
- Redirects: no loops; all 12 merge redirects resolve in one hop. http://www takes 2 hops (optional fix). Category schema lists 5 redirected posts.
- HTTPS: clean, no mixed content.
- Duplicates: self-canonicals everywhere. Two empty theme categories are indexable and identical; two category archives share a title; 4 noindex URLs still in the sitemap.
- Orphans: none true. 6 city pages (Litchfield Park, Superior, Apache Junction, Youngtown, Sacaton, El Mirage) are linked only from the menu; 9 posts only from listings and prev/next cards.
- Depth: deepest real page is 3 clicks (54 pages at 1, 39 at 2, 19 at 3).

# Decisions and status
- Proposed, needs approval: add the 8 redirects from the Sep 24 list, fix the schema image addresses in OTTO, remove the 5 hidden related-pages blocks, noindex the empty categories, give the archives distinct titles, add 1 to 2 in-content links to each menu-only page.

# Files in this folder (rollups only)
- `findings.csv`, `inbound-links.csv` (per-URL inbound link sources and click depth).
- Saved HTML (`html/`, category "before" copies, `home_now.html`, `mesa_post.html`), JSON crawl outputs and Python scripts.
